# Each was two byte-verified bodies disagreeing about one slot. Resolved from the code:

column3: CONFLICT g_activegadget Object(7 files) vs TGadget(8 files) -- TGadget. Field +0x40 is LOADED and compared against 0x005B95D0 (the empty function) at 0x005114C7 and then CALLED as `call [eax+0x40]` at 0x00511516, so +0x40 is a function-pointer field: only TGadget.fHit()i fits. 0x00514C5D is GetActiveGadgetName -- returns +0x0C directly as $ with the empty-string literal 0x00C5D284 as the null fallback, so +0x0C is `name $`. Slot 0x6C is called with two String args (0x00C5D680="FFFFFF") = TGadget.SetColour($,$)i; slot 0x70 = SetAlph(f). Stored value is the result of bbObjectDowncast(o,0x00C62150=TGadget) at 0x005123AB, so the declared type must be TGadget or an ancestor. 14 release sites => reference, not Int. Slots {0x34,0x4C,0x6C,0x70} + fields {0xC,0x28,0x2C,0x38,0x3C,0x40,0x44,0x54,0x58} narrow 348 scopes to 6 (TBall,TCompetition,TGadget,THorse,TPlayer,TProfile); of those only TGadget is assignable from a TGadget and only TGadget has a ()i at +0x40.

CONFLICT g_contractoffer_tplayer TPlayer(1 file) vs TProfile(3 files) -- TProfile, and the NAME is the wrong guess. Construction site 0x004BB9E2: `push 0x00C6A4C0; call 0x004A8F20` and 0x00C6A4C0 is TProfile's class table => `New TProfile`. Independently, the 39 slots and 3 field offsets dispatched directly through it intersect to exactly 1 of 348 scopes: TProfile. TPlayer is impossible on size alone -- instance_size 396 (0x18C) cannot hold the field at +0x1A4 that TContractOffer.EraseInterestedClubs writes; TProfile is 544 (0x220). The superseded TPlayer row came from "only TPlayer has slots 0x30,0x34,0x3c,0x40", an unsound uniqueness claim (143 Types share them).

NOT a type conflict: `g_wheel` is one NAME over TWO addresses. This one is assigned at 0x00575533 from `call [0x00C6BE3C]` = TRouletteWheel classtable (0x00C6BE0C) + 0x30 = Create():TRouletteWheel -- a factory's declared return type. Renamed g_roulettewheel; it pairs with 0x00C6BBC0 g_ball:TRouletteBall, built by the same initialiser at 0x00575511.

The other `g_wheel`. Assigned at 0x00575B06 from LoadImageChecked(0x004BC372, sig ($,i):TImage) loading Casino/Roulette/Wheel.png, then passed to MidHandleImage. No slot is ever dispatched through it and no field read off it -- the type comes purely from the factory return type. Keeps the name g_wheel; pairs with 0x00C6BCB8 g_wheelinner:TImage. g_player_int26: listed Int. The single store at 0x004EC1AC is a textbook reference assignment -- `mov ebx,eax / inc [ebx+4]` (retain) then `mov eax,[0xC5DE2C] / dec [eax+4] / jne / push eax / call 0x4A8590` (release + bbGCFree) then `mov [0xC5DE2C],ebx`. Refcount traffic decides the type (codegen-patterns 11.2), so it is a reference, not an Int. String rather than an object because the stored value is the return of the settings reader 0x004BC1D1, whose not-found path is `mov eax,0xC5D284 / jmp epilogue` -- 0x00C5D284 is the empty-string literal, i.e. `Return ""`, so the function is declared :String. Key read is "spritename_player" from "incbin::Inc/Engine.ini".

g_screen_mainmenu_int25: listed Int. Pushed as arg1 of _bbStringConcat (0x004A7C20) at 0x0051C3E4 with no Int->String conversion anywhere on the path; pushed into _bbStringCompare (0x004A6A30) at 0x0051D0B0 and 0x0051D0D2 against 0x00C639FC and 0x00C63A00; and at 0x0051D983 loaded with a retain (inc [ebx+4]) and stored into 0x00C639FC, which globals_corrections.tsv ALREADY types String. A String-to-String assignment. Corroborated independently by the byte-verified TScreen_MainMenu.UpdateVersionInfo, which declares it :String.
